evidence.name: Five dummy identities sign in through hosted native Auth
Hosted RLS isolates groups and ignores forged user metadata
Anonymous, master-document and direct role-write access denied
Task persistence, stale-edit detection and cross-group denial over HTTP
Reflection author binding, group privacy and coordinator review over HTTP
Native session refresh preserves permitted persistent data
Native sign-out completes for all test sessions

limits: Password-auth fixtures verify native sessions and HTTP/RLS. Email OTP and Next.js browser onboarding require separate validation.
